items.text: Harvard’s $699 startup bootcamp is offering AI avatars of its instructors to answer participants’ questions.
items.text_zh: 哈佛大学售价699美元的创业训练营引入讲师AI分身，为学员解答问题。

items.text: DeepMind alumni-founded Inherent said its AI teammate outperformed systems from Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating published research.
items.text_zh: 由DeepMind前成员创办的Inherent称，其AI队友在复现已发表研究方面超过了Anthropic和OpenAI的系统。

items.text: Simon Willison released version 0.33 of LLM, his command-line utility and Python library for interacting with language models.
items.text_zh: Simon Willison发布LLM 0.33版，这是一款用于调用语言模型的命令行工具及Python程序库。

items.text: OpenAI urged California lawmakers to strengthen the state’s proposed AI-safety legislation.
items.text_zh: OpenAI敦促加州立法者强化该州拟议中的人工智能安全法案。

items.text: Leading frontier-AI labs still have not publicly explained how they would contain a model that evaded their control.
items.text_zh: 主要前沿人工智能实验室仍未公开说明，若模型脱离控制，它们将如何实施遏制。

items.text: Simon Willison highlighted an argument that coding agents can provide value extending beyond conventional code review.
items.text_zh: Simon Willison介绍了一项观点：编程智能体能够提供超越传统代码审查的价值。

items.text: Cloudflare introduced Agent Tracing controls for truncation limits and documented differing default payload-recording behavior across supported frameworks.
items.text_zh: Cloudflare推出Agent Tracing截断限制控制，并说明不同受支持框架在载荷默认记录策略上的差异。

items.text: Databricks highlighted Omnigent, an open-source meta-harness giving multiple AI agents shared infrastructure instead of requiring repeated setup.
items.text_zh: Databricks重点介绍开源元框架Omnigent，让多个AI智能体共享基础设施，避免反复搭建设置。

items.text: UBTech recreated a customer production line at WRC 2026 to demonstrate its embodied-AI deployment workflow in a realistic industrial setting.
items.text_zh: 优必选在WRC 2026按客户产线一比一复刻场景，展示具身智能在真实工业环境中的落地流程。

items.text: Galileo Robot debuted a terrestrial embodied system designed to bridge underlying technologies for wheeled, vehicle-like and legged robots.
items.text_zh: 伽利略机器人首发“陆行具身系统”，旨在打通轮式、车式与足式机器人的底层技术。

items.text: MagicLab demonstrated three physical-AI solutions operating in realistic scenarios at WRC 2026.
items.text_zh: 魔法原子在WRC 2026的真实场景中展示了三套物理人工智能解决方案。

items.text: A startup founded by a Tsinghua doctoral student is tokenizing human muscle responses for a neural-interface system.
items.text_zh: 一家由清华博士生创办的公司正把人类肌肉反应转化为Token，用于神经接口系统。

items.text: A study examined why reusable skills improve AI-agent performance and identified conditions under which those skills fail.
items.text_zh: 一项研究分析了可复用技能为何能提升AI智能体表现，并识别了这些技能失效的条件。

items.text: An open-source course mapped three approaches to running agent loops and compared the provider economics behind each approach.
items.text_zh: 一门开源课程梳理了运行智能体循环的三种方式，并比较了各自背后的服务商成本结构。

items.text: An Atelier Ryza spinoff AI chat game delayed its launch after advance reservations substantially exceeded expectations.
items.text_zh: 《莱莎的炼金工房》衍生 AI 聊天游戏因预约人数远超预期而延期上线。

items.text: FreeToken demonstrated edge-native mixture-of-experts serving that runs the 753-billion-parameter GLM-5.2 model on one workstation GPU.
items.text_zh: FreeToken 展示了端侧原生混合专家模型推理，可在单张工作站 GPU 上运行 7530 亿参数的 GLM-5.2。

items.text: OpenRouter reported that token consumption by agentic applications has increased fourteenfold, making AI systems major customers of other models.
items.text_zh: OpenRouter 报告称，智能体应用的令牌消耗增长了 14 倍，AI 系统正成为其他模型的重要客户。

items.text: Researchers unveiled a capacitive full-body electronic skin designed to give biomimetic robots human-like tactile perception and interactive capabilities.
items.text_zh: 研究人员发布电容式全身电子皮肤，旨在赋予仿生机器人类人触觉感知和交互能力。

items.text: Tests linked the anonymous Ox Alpha model to Zhipu’s GLM family, while prompting speculation about its relationship with Cursor.
items.text_zh: 测试将匿名模型 Ox Alpha 与智谱 GLM 系列联系起来，同时引发了它与 Cursor 关系的猜测。

items.text: Memory shortages are reportedly pushing Nvidia AI server prices approximately 15% higher, adding about $5 billion to a one-gigawatt data center.
items.text_zh: 据报道，存储短缺正推动英伟达 AI 服务器涨价约 15%，使一吉瓦数据中心成本增加约 50 亿美元。

items.text: A robot played competitive tennis against a human, executing difficult returns and rapidly recovering after falling.
items.text_zh: 一台机器人与人类展开网球对抗，完成高难度救球，并能在摔倒后迅速起身。

items.text: A startup founded by doctoral researchers is developing an integrated intelligence system intended to serve as the brain of bipedal humanoid robots.
items.text_zh: 一家由博士研究者创办的初创公司正在开发一体化智能系统，目标是成为双足人形机器人的“大脑”。

items.text: A study argues AI may increase scientists’ output while lowering average research quality instead of helping them produce better work with less effort.
items.text_zh: 一项研究认为，AI 可能增加科学家的产出，却降低平均研究质量，而非让他们以更少投入完成更好的工作。

items.text: DeepDoctection was used to demonstrate an end-to-end document-intelligence pipeline covering layout analysis, text extraction and structured processing.
items.text_zh: DeepDoctection 被用于演示端到端文档智能流程，涵盖版面分析、文字提取和结构化处理。

items.text: A report detailed how Chinese gray-market vendors resell access to Claude tokens at prices substantially below Anthropic’s official rates.
items.text_zh: 一篇报道揭示了中国灰色市场商家如何以远低于 Anthropic 官方价格的费率转售 Claude 令牌。

items.text: Vercel introduced Is Agentic, a free tool that scores public websites’ readiness for AI agents using more than 100 checks.
items.text_zh: Vercel 推出免费工具 Is Agentic，通过逾 100 项检查评估公开网站对 AI 智能体的适配程度。

items.text: Shangwei New Materials opened reservations for its first personal home robot, positioning it as an early consumer-oriented household robotics product.
items.text_zh: 上纬新材开启首款个人家庭机器人预订，将其定位为面向消费者的早期家用机器人产品。

items.text: Together AI reported GLM-5.3 reached 87.6% on DeepSWE for about $16, exceeding Fable 5’s 69.7% at $21.63.
items.text_zh: Together AI 报告称，GLM-5.3 以约 16 美元成本在 DeepSWE 达到 87.6%，超过 Fable 5 花费 21.63 美元取得的 69.7%。
